pixel_diff.method: Crop the map pane from each frame, convert to RGB, take the per-channel absolute difference. mean_abs_diff is over all channels; pct_pixels_changed_gt8 is the share of pixels whose max channel delta exceeds 8/255. Computed from the COMMITTED JPEGs in this directory, not from the source PNGs, so re-derivation reproduces these values exactly.

determinism.question: Four round-3 frames hash-match earlier ones. On pixels alone that is indistinguishable from recycled files, so it was challenged. Settled by re-capture.
determinism.conclusion: The Playwright capture is deterministic at a fixed camera with cached tiles and no animation - across sessions and across builds. A recycled file cannot be regenerated by a live browser run; T3 regenerated the committed bytes exactly.

determinism.guard_note: Do NOT add a guard that fails when a frame sha256 appears in a prior commit: under determinism it fires on every honest re-shoot of an unchanged state, and the pressure fix is to perturb the capture, destroying the reproducibility that is the actual proof. Sound version: assert the capture log wrote each committed path in this run, and require any prior-commit hash match to be explained by re-capture or labelled reused-.

evidence_roles.frames: corroborate the destination / final state; journey-blind by construction under a deterministic renderer
